items.title: More climate money for Africa? Europe says use what's already pledged
items.summary: African countries at the UN climate summit in Turkey are demanding more funding from developed nations to help them cope with climate change.

items.title: Could Pete Buttigieg be the first gay US president? – podcast
items.summary: Democrats who might be thinking of launching a presidential run in 2028 are starting to make moves. One such contender is Pete Buttigieg, the former transportation secretary under Joe Biden. Is he the candidate who can unite the broad church in his party?
